plugins.name: Highlight mentions
plugins.description: Wash messages that mention you.

plugins.name: Code badge
plugins.description: Mark messages that contain a code block.

plugins.name: Hide joins
plugins.description: Drop member join and other system lines.

plugins.name: Edit log
plugins.description: Badge a message after it is edited.

plugins.name: Collapse long messages
plugins.description: Fold messages longer than 280 characters.

plugins.name: Translate
plugins.description: Local glossary only. No network, no token.

plugins.name: Message translator
plugins.description: Click Translate for a local phrase book. No network and no token.

plugins.name: Inline syntax
plugins.description: Color inline code the same way fenced blocks are colored.

plugins.name: Quiet media
plugins.description: Hide link previews and shrink images. The link text stays.

plugins.name: Send later
plugins.description: Queue one message at a time from the composer. Nothing sends early, and nothing sends in a burst.

plugins.name: Quick reactions
plugins.description: A short emoji bar on hover. One click is one reaction, same as the picker.

plugins.name: Keyword ping
plugins.description: Highlight words, and ping on a mentions-only channel when one appears. Mute still wins.

plugins.name: Auto away
plugins.description: After a few quiet minutes, set idle once. Activity sets you back. Do not disturb stays put.

plugins.name: Now playing
plugins.description: Put a listening line on your status. Manual, or the media session if the system exposes one. No Spotify login and no token.

plugins.name: Bookmarks
plugins.description: Save messages on this device. Nothing is pinned on Discord.

plugins.name: Hide muted people
plugins.description: Drop messages from people you hide locally. This does not block them on Discord.

plugins.name: Relative time
plugins.description: Show 3m ago instead of the clock. The tooltip stays the local date and time.

plugins.name: Silent typing
plugins.description: Keep the typing indicator to yourself. Lark does not send one while this is on.

plugins.name: Call Timer
plugins.description: Shows how long you have been in the voice channel.

plugins.name: Volume Booster
plugins.description: Raise one person's volume up to 400%. Mute for you still silences them.

plugins.name: Message logger
plugins.description: Keep deleted and edited messages on this device. Deleted lines stay, greyed out, with the earlier text.

plugins.name: Better timestamps
plugins.description: Absolute or relative time, with a 12-hour or 24-hour clock. Hover the time for the full date.

plugins.name: Typing indicators
plugins.description: Show who is typing on the channel row and the direct message row.

plugins.name: Translate
plugins.description: Right-click a message to translate it in place. Uses a free endpoint, then a local phrase book. No key.

plugins.name: Show hidden channels
plugins.description: List channels you cannot view, with a lock and the topic. Opening one is refused.

plugins.name: Spotify controls
plugins.description: A mini player in the user panel from the listening line and Spotify links. No login and no key.

plugins.name: Panic Key
plugins.description: A hotkey that hides or minimizes Lark and mutes.

plugins.name: Incognito Mode
plugins.description: Don't mark channels read until you choose, and hide your activity on this device.
